interpretation.primary: Twelve categories not used in the local A1/R1 development rounds; settings frozen before their evaluation.
interpretation.development: Three previously inspected categories are reused and reported separately.
interpretation.secondary: All fifteen categories are descriptive; do not substitute this combined result for the primary twelve-category result.
interpretation.limitations: One benchmark and three reference-sampling seeds; common test images and conditions are correlated. No SOTA claim, significance claim, test-label tuning, checkpoint reselection or outcome-based category omission.
